dog.description_text:
Meet Pedri — the Little Polar Bear! 🐻‍❄️

With his almost pure white coat, Pedri earned his nickname the honest way. But don’t let the tough-guy bear name fool you — this boy is all snuggles.

Pedri is the last boy left in his litter, and he’s clearly enjoying his time as the center of attention among his sisters. Play sessions with his foster siblings bring out his sweetest side — despite being the lone boy in the group, he’s the gentlest of the bunch, always mindful with his three sisters. He’s a lover, not a fighter.

After all that playtime, Pedri is also the first to call it quits for a nap. He’ll wear himself out having fun, then curl up for some well-earned rest — and he loves nothing more than snuggling up close while he does it.

If you’re looking for a sweet, snuggly boy who plays gently and naps hard, Pedri might just be your little polar bear. 🤍

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs.

Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
